owner: the maintainers of the example harness

ask-owner-structured.mechanism: the example harness asks the owner through a form and records the answer in the run record

plan-mode.mechanism: the example harness starts every design task in a mode where the agent may read but not write

spawn-role-isolated.mechanism: the example harness starts each role as a separate process with its own instructions

model-tier.mechanism: the example harness selects an adequate model for the task's hardest necessary step through the three model parameters under explicit selection authority; concrete configuration declares supported effort/settings and distinguishes requested from exposed observed identity

role-permissions.mechanism: the example harness gives a role a list of tools it may call and refuses the rest

pre-tool-guard.mechanism: the example harness runs a guard script before every tool call and blocks a call the guard rejects

run-state-persist.mechanism: the example harness writes the run state to a file after every step and resumes from it

workflow-orchestration.mechanism: the example harness sequences the phases with a small script rather than with the agent's judgment

structured-output.mechanism: the example harness asks a role for one object and rejects an answer that does not match the schema

skill-loading.mechanism: the example harness loads a protocol file into the context when a role names it

rules-injection.mechanism: the example harness places its rules file at the start of every session

session-start-hook.mechanism: the example harness runs an orientation script whenever a session opens

background-command.mechanism: the example harness starts a long command as a detached process and reads its output later

web-research.mechanism: the example harness lets a research role call a search tool and a page fetcher

browser.mechanism: the example harness lets a verifier role drive a headless browser and read the page structure

worktree.mechanism: the example harness gives each parallel task its own checkout of the repository

schedule.fallback: the owner starts scheduled work by hand

memory.mechanism: the example harness keeps memory in the project's handoff and notes files and names no external knowledge source

todo-list.mechanism: the example harness keeps the agent's task list in a file that the agent updates during the run

goal.fallback: the goal is kept in the project's task file

code-map-build.mechanism: the example harness builds the code map with the documentation generator before a task begins

check-runner.mechanism: the example harness runs the target project's own test command and reads its exit code

run-record-access.mechanism: the example harness stores every run as a folder of records that a reviewer can open afterwards

packaging-install.mechanism: the example harness copies the methodology into its own repository with one script and records the version

launch-environment.mechanism: the example harness starts each run in a clean directory with its own environment variables

context-management.fallback: the session ends and resumes from the handoff file

tracker-integration.fallback: tasks are kept in the project's task file
